prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: country learning postcard for Bahrain
Primary request: Qal'at al-Bahrain, the historic honey-stone fort beside Bahrain's flat northern coast.
Subject: Recognizable broad low Portuguese fort of weathered pale honey limestone, thick ramparts, rounded bastions and angular defensive walls, simple entrance opening and low archaeological foundations on a gently raised sandy tell.
Scene/backdrop: Flat coastal ground, calm blue-turquoise Gulf visible beyond the fort, a few date palms and sparse green gardens, clear blue sky. The fort sits on land, not an island in an ocean moat.
Style/medium: Cheerful detailed children's-book travel illustration, painterly gouache and digital watercolour with visible brush texture, believable landmark geometry, gentle saturated teal, ochre, green and coral.
Composition/framing: One landscape 3:2 image, intended 1536x1024. Wide three-quarter view; whole low fort comfortably centered inside central 75% width and height, with breathing room for cropping.
Lighting/mood: Warm natural daylight, welcoming and calm.
Constraints: Stylized educational illustration. No text or letters, UI, flags, logos, watermark, postcard frame or stamp. No towering fairy castle, mountains, giant mosque, unrelated landmark or invented geography.
inspection: Inspected: broad low honey-stone coastal fort with round bastions, angular ramparts, sandy tell, date palms and flat blue coast. No readable text, flags, UI or logos. Fort extends outside the central 75% width; app contain sizing preserves the whole scene. Stylized architecture rather than a measured reconstruction.
